text:
maria (PM): quick check-in — we got three customer complaints after launch: embeddings drift on long docs, occasional 500s on /generate, and a UX flow that confuses workspace owners. need to decide hotfixes vs. next-wave enhancements. propose triage criteria: impact x frequency + cost to fix. thoughts?

devin (eng): +1 on triage criteria. can we get counts from the last 72h? latency spikes look correlated with long-context requests. i can surface traces but need sampling window.

sam (cs): i have three accounts asking for priority fixes (two enterprise, one startup). asks are: 1) stopgap for embeddings accuracy, 2) reduce /generate errors for single-tenant dedicated customers, 3) UX copy tweak. customers said "blocking" for embedding drift on legal docs.

ashok (eng-lead): from infra side, /generate 500s are likely KV cache churn during bursts. we can roll a config change to increase cache TTL for the next 24h as a low-risk mitigation. hotfix estimate: ~2h ops+1h smoke.

lina (product-ops): for prioritization matrix i suggest labels: P0-hotfix (customer-blocking/security), P1-fast-follow (small dev work < 3d), P2-roadmap (larger scope). map the three asks: embeddings -> P0/P1 (depends repro), 500s -> P0 (prod errors), UX -> P1.

maria (PM): agree. Devin — can you add quick repro for embeddings drift? if it's deterministic we escalate P0. if noisy, schedule P1. Sam, can you collect two example inputs from each customer and drop in the shared triage folder?

sam (cs): yes will drop examples in /shared/postlaunch/embeddings-drift by EOD. pinging @maria when uploaded :thumbsup: 

devin (eng): got a sample from sam earlier, reproduced locally with a long doc (~12k tokens). reproduction notes:
```
# repro steps
1. curl -X POST /v1/embeddings -d '{"model":"open-embedding-3","input":"<long legal doc>"}'
2. compute cosine vs baseline
```
observed embedding L2 drift across runs. likely floating-point nondeterminism + chunking boundary effects. quick mitigations: canonical chunking, fixed RNG seed in preprocessing. spike estimate: 1 day to validate + 1 day to roll.

ashok (eng-lead): i can schedule the cache-TTL roll now as a hotfix and run canary in prod for 3 hours. if successful, we keep for 48h then revert or make permanent after perf review.

lina (product-ops): recommend first wave: 1) cache-TTL hotfix (P0) — ship within 6h; 2) collect embeddings examples + reproduce (P0->P1 decision) — complete 48h; 3) UX copy tweak (P1) — ship in next sprint if no blocking.

maria (PM): decision: approve cache-TTL hotfix now, devin + ashok pair to validate canary, sam to upload examples. schedule a 30m async sync tomorrow 10:30am PT for final go/no-go on embeddings roll. if repro is deterministic, we fast-track a 2-day patch.

deploy-bot: Deploy initiated by ashok at 1767890200. Canary on 10% traffic. Monitor: /metrics/errors, /metrics/p99-latency.

devin (eng): will start the embeddings spike after canary validation. logging two acceptance tests: stability across 5 runs, and no customer-facing regressions on small docs.

sam (cs): uploaded examples (folders: enterprise-A, enterprise-B, startup-C). left notes with highlights. will follow up with customers after the hotfix.

maria (PM): thanks team. I'll update the roadmap board: create ticket for embeddings: triage -> spike -> fastfix (if confirmed). UX copy to grooming backlog. Closing this thread; ping me if anything blocks the canary.

ashok (eng-lead): canary metrics look healthy at +3h, errors down 78%. rolling to 50% now.

deploy-bot: Rollout updated by ashok at 1767892500. 50% traffic.

devin (eng): embeddings spike PoC complete. deterministic via canonical chunking + stable seed. raising PR for patch (estimate 1.5d). tagging for review @lina @maria.

maria (PM): nice. mark embeddings as P0 -> fastfix approved, scoped to 2 days. moving UX copy to next sprint. reopening if customers report new issues.
